motivation.question: What motivated you to apply for this position?
motivation.text: The AI Engineer role at RightShip stands out to me for its focus on safety and risk intelligence. At AstraZeneca, I wrote a three-tier test framework of ~65 tests across 8 files, validated across the LLM provider migration from Groq to AWS Bedrock after a rate-limit evaluation. I want to build AI systems that are trustworthy in production, not just demos: tested, measured and safe when their dependencies fail. I enjoy taking a loosely defined problem from prototype to something a team uses in production.
motivations_left_out: I am drawn to applied AI in domains where correctness matter (names health; the company is not)
